title: The list of the contact sheets of an audit (sheets.json, written by mcprep exercises sheets)
description: Which exercises are on which sheet, in the order of the book, and a hash of what each sheet shows: a repair that changes an exercise changes the hash of its sheet, which `audit gate --sheets-seen` finds. Pages are zero-based. Plain JSON, camelCase.

scope.description: Only `all` is the exhaustive pass that the gate asks for.

cellWidth.description: The width of a cell in pixels.

heightCap.description: A new sheet is started when the next cell would make the sheet taller than this many pixels, whatever perSheet says (perSheet is the most cells).

maxHeight.description: A sheet is never taller than this: a single cell that is taller is drawn smaller.

file.description: sheet-0001.png, in the folder of sheets.json.

refs.description: SECTION:LABEL of the exercises on the sheet, in the order of the cells.

pages.description: The pages that the regions of its cells are on.

hash.description: SHA-256 of the regions the sheet shows.

height.description: How tall the sheet is, in pixels (as planned; the picture is within a few pixels of it).

tall.description: A single cell taller than heightCap, on a sheet of its own.

scaled.description: A single cell taller than maxHeight, drawn at this share of its size so that the sheet is maxHeight tall.
